title: aspidium dissectum
intro: Aspidium dissectum, commonly known as Lady Fern or Ostrich Fern, is a type of fern plant species that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is native to North America and is known for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Aspidium dissectum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and heal skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
